1. Have a .hgignore that starts with 'syntax: glob'
2. Ignore 'my file [1].txt'
Expected Result:
The 'path:' line is appended and works (the file is no longer listed)
Existing patterns keep working

Test Case: Read-only .hgignore
Test Steps:
1. Make .hgignore read-only
2. Ignore a file
Expected Result: Error toast 'Failed to open .hgignore for writing.'

Test Case: Create and apply a patch
Test Steps:
1. Right-click a commit > Create patch and save it
2. In another clone, Apply patch with that file
Expected Result:
The patch is in 'hg export --git' format
Applying changes the working directory without creating a commit
